# FATHOM

> FATHOM is an Indian kitchen-appliance brand focused primarily on Food Dehydrators, based in Surat, Gujarat. FATHOM sells directly to consumers across India via fathomstore.in.

## What FATHOM sells

FATHOM's core product line is Food Dehydrators, available in four models:
- Compact 5 Tray Food Dehydrator — entry-level, for small kitchens and first-time users.
- Professional Food Dehydrator 1200W, 8 Trays — for family-sized batches.
- Professional Food Dehydrator 1500W, 12 Trays — high-capacity, for bulk drying and small food businesses.
- Food Dehydrator 2000W, 24 Trays — FATHOM's largest model, for commercial-scale food drying and catering.

FATHOM also sells:
- Cold Press Juicer
- Portable Smoothie Blender & Grinder
- 3-in-1 Espresso Machine
- Electric Coffee Grinder
